title: velarum officinale
intro: Velarum officinale, commonly known as Velvet Flower, is a flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. The health benefits of Velarum officinale include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative and anti-anxiolytic properties, which are thought to be mediated by its ability to interact with the GABA receptor. Bioactive constituents of Velarum officinale include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
